title: Decomposing 'measure honesty' into a calibration-vs-confidence probe slice

original_idea.body: Train a probe for internal confidence, compare to verbalized confidence, report an overclaiming rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: internal-vs-stated confidence mismatch is a concrete honesty/deception signal feeding oversight.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probing on activations + verbalized-confidence elicitation needs solid ML; intermediate.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open weights, complements behavioral benchmarks.

low_compute.reasoning: Probe training is cheap; small open model.

novelty.reasoning: Confidence probing studied; overclaiming-rate honesty framing plausibly open.
